angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 108,251 km at 32.33 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 30.9326 +/- 0.0418 mas (same row, RUWE 1.09): 32.33 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.1556 +/- 0.0086 solar radii from Delrez et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of LP 890-9 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract): 108,251 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.118 +/- 0.002 solar masses from Delrez et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of LP 890-9 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 2850 +/- 75 K from Delrez et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of LP 890-9 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Delrez et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of LP 890-9 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/lp-890-9.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.126, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 890-9 (pscomppars): spectral type M6 V, from Delrez et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, LP 890-9: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 890-9 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.028 dex, from Delrez et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 890-9 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.84134, from Delrez et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 890-9 (pscomppars): age 7.2 Gyr, from Delrez et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..59D/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
